scope.purpose: First-pass Scripture indexing of the 94 most geometrically precise three-proper-name chains.

methodology.geometry: Copied unchanged from the archived astronomical corpus.
methodology.hrSemanticMatch: Model-reviewed mapping from the existing Heavens Remember semantic labels to biblical references. References are stored without quotation text.
methodology.starNameLayer: Disabled for interpretation in this pass. Star-name etymologies require source-by-source philological verification.
methodology.independenceWarning: Because the HR semantic labels are already theological, matches in hrSemanticMatch are not independent evidence for the underlying hypothesis.

statuses.strong: A single passage or tightly connected passage cluster naturally covers most or all three HR semantic elements.
statuses.plausible: The elements form a coherent biblical motif, but require more than one passage or some synthesis.
statuses.weak: Biblical anchors exist for individual elements, but no natural three-element passage/motif was found.
statuses.no_match: Reserved for cases where even a coherent biblical motif is absent.

methodology.scoreScale: 0-5; forcedness is inverse quality (0 best, 5 most forced).
